verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents a built-in Email Assistant that labels, archives, drafts replies in your voice using inbox, calendar and web context, and reminds you to follow up. Ask AI answers questions about your inbox, and a chat or visual builder creates agents that run proactively on triggers. Most of this is automatic background delegation rather than an in-product assistant you hand arbitrary tasks to; the MCP integration routes work through external assistants, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented free-form task delegation to the in-app assistant beyond Q&A and pre-set automations, detail on the in-app agent builder's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Get an email assistant that automatically labels incoming emails, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies, and reminds you to follow up.
Email Assistant organizes your inbox, drafts replies in your voice, and keeps every follow-up on track, all inside Gmail or Outlook.
Each draft can use your inbox, calendar, and the web to write replies that are ready to send.
Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.
Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
